documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for the financial year 2025-26, crossing the INR 1,000 Crore revenue milestone driven by capacity expansions in value-added coated steel such as Alu-Zinc and colour-coated lines. The company maintained a conservative, debt-light balance sheet with zero long-term debt and improved capital efficiency, profitability, and credit ratings. Management outlined forward revenue targets of INR 1,500 Crore for FY 2026-27 and INR 3,000 Crore for FY 2028-29, backed by planned investments including a new 90,000 TPA colour-coated line and a INR 100 Crore cold-rolling mill. Additionally, the company is shifting from bulk import cycles to domestic raw material sourcing to improve working capital efficiency. Manaksia Steels Limited reported its financial and operational performance for FY 2024-25, highlighting revenue of H584.18 Crore and a 15% increase in sales volume by tonnage.

guidance.claim: The new integrated Alu-Zinc production line is expected to result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.
guidance.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.

guidance.claim: The colour coating manufacturing line expansion is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.
guidance.quote: This investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of galvalume, galvanized, and colour-coated steel.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure

capex_expansion.claim: A second expansion programme of H40 Crore comprises the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line.

capex_expansion.claim: The colour coating manufacturing line expansion will enhance the company's manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin weakened to 4.40% in FY 2024-25 on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.
margins_costs.quote: During the last financial year, our EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported H48.07 Cr in EBITDA in FY 2023-24, which is noted as the highest in its existence and almost twice that in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Your Company reported H48.07 Cr in EBITDA in FY 2023-24, the highest in its existence and almost twice that in the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-painted profile sheets accounted for 42% of the company's manufacturing turnover in FY 2024-25.
orders_capacity.quote: Equipped to produce roofing profiles in Trapezoidal and Sinusoidal shapes, this segment accounted for 42% of the Company’s manufacturing turnover in FY 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated H16.56 Crore in cash profit during the year under review, which was deployed to address capital expenditure and working capital needs.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company generated H16.56 Crore in cash profit during the year under review. This was deployed to address capital expenditure and working capital needs.

risks_headwinds.claim: PAT declined by 61.28% to H11.70 Crore during FY 2024-25 compared to the previous year.
risks_headwinds.quote: Your Company reported H11.70 Crore of PAT during FY 2024-25, which was 61.28% lower than previous year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

management_commitments.claim: The second expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year, generating revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to report a better performance from FY 2025-26 onwards following the commissioning of its new capacities.
management_commitments.quote: The Company expects to report a better performance from FY 2025-26 onwards following the commissioning its new capacities.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
